2.12.5 Image.CustomProperties
The Image.CustomProperties element specifies custom information for an Image instance that will
be handed to a report rendering component. This element is optional. This element is of type
CustomProperties.
Following is the parent element of the Image.CustomProperties element.
Parent elements
Image
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Image.CustomProperties element.
 <xsd:element name="CustomProperties" type="CustomPropertiesType" minOccurs="0" />
In RDL 2003/10, the equivalent element of Image.CustomProperties is Image.Custom, which is of
type Custom.
